head: a47762a

smoke.notes: Repo's own fail-closed verifier, read-only: 'OK chain 7 rows, tip 09e84771c690..., claims 3/6, registration seal verified' exit 0. Honest negatives: (1) `node run.mjs` was NOT executed in-repo because it writeFileSync's receipts/run.json (run.mjs:211) and this lane must not modify a studied repo; instead core/world.js + core/jepa.js + core/mesh.js were dog-fooded in a /tmp scratch harness: world determinism across twin seeds PASS, JEPA loss 0.01112 -> 0.00777 over 120 trainSteps on the trivial world PASS, mesh energy total drift 0.0 over 10 steps PASS, variance non-increasing PASS (my first harness run had a self-inflicted warm-up-tick asymmetry, disclosed and fixed). (2) The README's headline 3/6 is run 1 of 10; verdict-v10 records 22/28 with DOSE10/SAT10/DIP10 honest FAILs.

essence: Tiny JEPA world model in a cell mesh: per-cell latents, EMA targets, conservation-law surprise diffusion, ten rounds of pre-registered claims.

ideas.name: The grid IS the latent space
ideas.statement: Each of the 16x16 cells holds its own 4-dim latent; a per-cell context encoder Wc and predictor Wp learn to predict the cell's own latent future against an EMA target encoder (tau, stop-gradient) — no pixel reconstruction anywhere.

ideas.name: Conservation-law surprise mesh
ideas.statement: A double-buffered Perona-Malik anisotropic diffusion (lambda=0.2 <= 0.25 stability bound) moves prediction-surprise across the mesh as pairwise symmetric exchange: energy is never minted nor destroyed and variance contracts.

ideas.name: Determinism as the foundation of every claim
ideas.statement: The world is xorshift32-seeded with no Math.random, so twin runs are byte-identical; every experiment is registered and sealed BEFORE the run, the run re-verifies the seal at startup fail-closed, and a stone chain + verifier make tampering loud.

ideas.name: Bit-exact claim re-binding across the depth ladder
ideas.statement: Rounds 4..10 form a ladder where every carried metric must re-bind bit-exactly (run4 29/29, run5 92/92, cross-round metric shas) while only new claims are measured fresh — concentration statistics, not global means (design law (b)) — and honest FAILs (DOSE10, SAT10, DIP10) are carried as verdicts, not hidden.

parts.name: xorshift32 deterministic seed
parts.essence: The only randomness source: a 32-bit xorshift generator; seed 0 is coerced to the golden-ratio constant so seed space is total.
parts.gate: no Math.random anywhere in core (determinism claim P4 PASS)
parts.failure_mode: any hidden nondeterminism voids every byte-exact cross-round binding

parts.name: wave + ball observation field
parts.essence: A 16x16 luminance field from two phased sinusoids plus a 2x2 ball bump clipped to 1 — the entire observable universe of the world model.

parts.name: per-cell 4-dim features
parts.essence: The local observable: [luminance, right-diff, down-diff, luminance-0.5] — the features each cell's encoder reads.

parts.name: per-cell context encoder Wc
parts.essence: One 4x4 matrix per cell (Float32Array CELLS*16), xorshift-seeded at scale 0.5; encode maps features to the cell's latent.

parts.name: per-cell predictor Wp
parts.essence: One 4x4 matrix per cell predicting the next latent from the current context latent — the JEPA's learned dynamics.

parts.name: EMA target encoder Wt (stop-gradient)
parts.essence: Wt = tau*Wt + (1-tau)*Wc with tau=0.999 (later pace-aware), providing the stable target the encoder chases — the law that prevents representation collapse.
parts.failure_mode: an unstable target would let the encoder chase itself into collapse

parts.name: clipped-SGD trainStep
parts.essence: One hand-derived step: gradient 2*(zPred - zTgt)/N clipped to [-1,1], backprop through Wp then Wc, returns the loss — plain readable autodiff by hand.
parts.gate: learning-sanity ratio 0.34923 == run4 pin, re-bound bit-exact through round 10
parts.failure_mode: P1_learning honestly FAILED on the easy world (ratio 0.948) in run 1 — kept as the verdict

parts.name: deterministic corruption probe
parts.essence: corruptWc flips the sign of a seeded fraction of Wc weights — the fault-injection lever for the zero-self-repair and cure-arm experiments.
parts.gate: P6_zero_self_repair honestly FAILed in run 1 (jump_ratio 0.979) — the fault was permanent, receipted as design law paid for

parts.name: stride-4 mesh cells
parts.essence: The mesh substrate: per-cell Float32 stride 4 [luminance, angle, gradient magnitude, latent/surprise energy], double-buffered with an active-side flag.
parts.failure_mode: lambda above 0.25 would make diffusion diverge

parts.name: Perona-Malik diffusion step
parts.essence: One pass on channel 3: each cell exchanges energy with 4 neighbors scaled by conductance exp(-((mc-nb)^2)/kappaSq) — flow pools in flat regions and stalls at edges.
parts.gate: total energy conserved to 1.2e-8 relative (P5 PASS; my scratch rerun measured 0.0 over 10 steps)
parts.failure_mode: any asymmetry in the pairwise exchange would mint or destroy energy

parts.name: variance contraction readout
parts.essence: totals() folds the active buffer into {total, mean, variance}; the registered law requires variance non-increasing under diffusion.

parts.name: surprise sampling policy
parts.essence: surprise(sampleIdx) is mean |energy| over chosen cells — upgraded across rounds to percentile-z concentration statistics rather than global means (design law (b): diluted mean-surprise was the root cause of run-1's anomaly FAIL).
parts.failure_mode: global mean-surprise diluted the anomaly signal — the honest FAIL that forced law (b)

parts.name: registration seal (masked self-sha + mtime)
parts.essence: Claims are sealed into registration.json BEFORE runs: the file hashes itself with its own sha field masked; the verifier recomputes and also binds the file mtime within 2s.
parts.gate: masked self-sha recomputes exactly AND |mtime - sealed| <= 2000ms else fail-closed
parts.failure_mode: file mutated after seal -> 'FAIL registration self-sha mismatch (file mutated after seal)'

parts.name: stone chain walk from GENESIS
parts.essence: Every receipt row hashes as sha(prev : canonical{i,id,type,payload} : id); the verifier re-derives the whole chain from the JEPA-GENESIS-1 constant and demands the tip match.
parts.gate: every row re-hashes to its pin, links parent-correct, tip equal; exit 0 only if everything re-hashes
parts.failure_mode: 'FAIL hash mismatch at row N' names the tampered row

parts.name: fail-closed startup seal re-verification
parts.essence: The run itself re-verifies the registration seal at startup and refuses to execute otherwise; the verdict is recorded in the receipt (seal_verified_at_startup).
parts.gate: seal verified at startup, else the run refuses
parts.failure_mode: running against a mutated registration would decouple claims from measurements

parts.name: bit-exact cross-round re-binding
parts.essence: Every round 4..9 metric must reproduce its round's receipt bit-exactly at sha level (run4 29/29, run5 92/92, design6/run6..run9 identities); the R4 twin executions are byte-identical (sha_round10_run1 == run2).
outputs: re-bound shas in the R4 row
parts.gate: any sha mismatch fails the run — the operating point (lr 0.3, tau 0.99998, K4, amp, seed) is UNCHANGED or the round is void
parts.failure_mode: a core arithmetic change would break ten rounds of pinned shas

parts.name: honest-FAIL verdicts carried forward
parts.essence: DOSE10, SAT10, DIP10 are scored FAIL on pre-priced branches; the round-8 MECH FAIL and round-9 CURE9/DIP9 FAILs carry — 22/28 with the failures in the scorecard, not footnotes.
parts.gate: claims_passed reported as measured, never rounded up

parts.name: browser demo labeled DESIGN-ONLY
parts.essence: demo/index.html is a WebGPU/WGSL visualization of the same architecture, explicitly never executed headless and never cited as evidence — the interface/artifact boundary is receipted in the README.
parts.gate: DESIGN/DEMO ONLY — no headless execution claim
parts.failure_mode: citing the demo as a verified result would be LARP

cells.expr: {total, variance} over active buffer; variance non-increasing
re-verify registration masked-sha + mtime at startup; refuse otherwise
scorecard over claims; honest FAILs carried

layer_logic.0: The substrate is a 16x16 lattice of per-cell 4-dim Float32 latents plus a stride-4 mesh [luminance, angle, gradient, energy] — the grid itself is the latent space.
layer_logic.1: The mechanism is encode->predict->diff against an EMA target per cell, and a double-buffered Perona-Malik exchange that moves surprise energy conservatively across the mesh.
layer_logic.2: The policy is the pre-registered claim rule set: sealed predictions before runs, percentile-z statistics instead of global means, dose-ordering decision laws, and fail-closed seal re-verification at startup.
layer_logic.3: The interface is run.mjs/verify.mjs (CLI in, JSON receipts out), registration/seal tools, and a browser demo explicitly fenced off as DESIGN-ONLY.
layer_logic.4: The evidence is stone chains verified from genesis, masked self-sha + mtime seals, twin-run byte-identical receipts, ten rounds of bit-exact metric re-binding, and honest FAILs (3/6 in run 1; DOSE10/SAT10/DIP10 in round 10) kept in the scorecard.
